description: Defines classes and types for managing QPACK header tables in QUIC, including encoder and decoder tables, with dynamic and static table management, and related methods.

classes.name: QpackHeaderTableBase
classes.description: Base class template for managing static and dynamic QPACK header tables, providing insertion, capacity management, and eviction functionalities.

classes.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the encoder's dynamic and static QPACK header tables, including header lookup and insertion, with additional features for avoiding blocked insertions.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the decoder's dynamic and static QPACK header tables, supports entry lookup, insertion, and observer notifications for insert count thresholds.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable::Observer
classes.description: Interface for observing insert count thresholds in the decoder header table.

methods.name: EntryFitsDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Checks if an entry with given name and value fits within the dynamic table capacity.

methods.name: InsertEntry
methods.description: Inserts a header entry into the dynamic table, possibly evicting older entries.

methods.name: SetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Sets the capacity of the dynamic table, evicting entries if necessary.

methods.name: SetMaximumDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed capacity for the dynamic table, only once.

methods.name: RemoveEntryFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the oldest entry from the end of the dynamic table.

methods.name: EvictDownToCapacity
methods.description: Evicts entries until the table size is within the specified capacity.

methods.name: FindHeaderField
methods.description: Finds a header field in the encoder table matching name and value.

methods.name: MaxInsertSizeWithoutEvictingGivenEntry
methods.description: Calculates the maximum size of an entry that can be inserted without eviction.

methods.name: draining_index
methods.description: Calculates the draining index to avoid blocked insertions.

methods.name: LookupEntry
methods.description: Retrieves an entry at a given index from static or dynamic table.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for insert count threshold notification.
